9b9cea50-ba3c-47af-94c1-a3cfcd83f215: I’m most proud of the real-time vision system I built for an autonomous badminton-training robot, because it forced me to make perception work under hardware and latency constraints rather than just in an offline notebook. I integrated player detection, pose estimation, shuttlecock tracking, and court localization into one pipeline and got it running at 20+ FPS. I also implemented stereo 3D shuttlecock tracking and landing-point prediction, then optimized Raspberry Pi inference with ONNX Runtime, quantization, and asynchronous video pipelines. That project maps closely to Fab2’s need for vision software that extracts reliable measurements from images and integrates with electromechanical systems.
